newsitem.title: USA: Sigma-Aldrich gets OK for deal in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Sigma-Aldrich gets OK for deal in Germany.

text.p: Sigma-Aldrich Corp said Thursday it has received approval from Germany's Federal Cartel Office to acquire a stake in a laboratory chemicals business of AlliedSignal Inc.

Sigma-Aldrich will have a 75-percent interest in the business, named RdH Laborchemikaliem GmbH & Co. The company formerly was part of AlliedSignal Specialty Chemicals' Riedel-de Haen unit, which kept a 25 percent ownership in the partnership.
The operation is based in Seelze, Germany. Sigma-Aldrich said it received clearance from the German agency for the acquisition on Wednesday, May 28.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

The business has sales of about $40 million and employs about 200 workers. Karsten Bode was named president of the partnership. Bode most recently was a vice president for Sigma-Aldrich at its Fluka subsidiary in Switzerland, Sigma-Alrich said.
